name: Akagi Misato
source:
After witnessing her son masturbating all the time instead of concentrating on his studies, she goes to the protagonist for advice regarding her son's "hypersexuality".

The protagonist asked her if her son's hypersexuality was hereditary, and a treatment for it would be for the two of them to engage in incest when they are both sexually excited.

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/5386]official site[/url]]
